core_obligations: Choose witnesses for K and L (proof lines 12190-12202): for an object U take a covering with strictly perfect complexes K_i and maps alpha_i to K|U_i with the pseudo-coherence properties in degree m+1; after replacing K_i by its truncation one may assume K_i^j = 0 for j < m+1, and after refining one finds strictly perfect L_i with maps beta_i to L|U_i with the properties in degree m.

Build a commutative diagram (proof lines 12203-12212): the lifting lemma allows the maps alpha_i, beta_i and K|U_i -> L|U_i to be represented by actual maps of complexes so that the displayed square commutes in the derived category (the author notes that some details are omitted here).

Compare cones (proof lines 12213-12228): the cone C(gamma_i) on the resulting map gamma_i is strictly perfect by the cone lemma, the commutativity gives a morphism of distinguished triangles (K_i, L_i, C(gamma_i)) -> (K|U_i, L|U_i, M|U_i), and the four and five lemmas applied to the induced map of long exact cohomology sequences show that C(gamma_i) -> M|U_i is an isomorphism above m and a surjection in degree m; locality of pseudo-coherence then gives that M is m-pseudo-coherent.
Parts (2) and (3) (proof lines 12230-12235): both follow from part (1) by rotating the distinguished triangle.
proof_roadmap: Choose strictly perfect witnesses for K and L with a degree of slack and truncate the first.
Lift the maps to an actual commutative square of complexes on a refinement and take the cone of the horizontal map.
Use the induced morphism of triangles plus the four and five lemmas to witness pseudo-coherence of M, and rotate for the other two parts.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes the behaviour of pseudo-coherence along a distinguished triangle with one degree of slack (statement lines 12176-12187). The proof (proof lines 12189-12235) chooses strictly perfect witnesses for K and L on a covering with the appropriate degree shifts, lifts the maps to an actual commutative square of complexes on a refinement, takes the cone of the horizontal map (strictly perfect by the cone lemma), and compares the resulting morphism of triangles through the four and five lemmas to witness the pseudo-coherence of M; the other two parts follow by rotation. H2: one cone construction plus one comparison of long exact sequences, written out.
